invoicing.policy: Invoicing 2.14.0 preserves the locked Parts 1–12 baseline and completes Part 13 Installments & Payment Plans with invoice-scoped schedules, exact balance reconciliation, settlement baselines for previously paid invoices, one active plan per invoice, dedicated PLN numbering, invoice due-date integration and restoration, FIFO installment settlement derived from the authoritative payment/credit ledger, customer portal visibility, operator schedule builder, cancellation audit and concurrency/idempotency safeguards. Future changes must keep Invoicing, ERP integration, platform closure, app-surface, core-hardening, TypeScript, migration dry-run and production deployment gates green.
